name: pointer
title: Pointer
description: Replaces the cursor with a custom animated pointer while hovering a container.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the default arrow, e.g. fill-blue-500.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra styles for the floating pointer element.

props.name: ...motion props
props.description: Any other attribute (initial, animate, exit, transition, …) is forwarded to the motion element that follows the cursor.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom pointer content. Defaults to an arrow. The real cursor is hidden only over the Pointer's parent element.
